items.example: She's a stunt double — she's afraid of nothing.
items.mnemonic: Пациентка Фрейда ничего не боится — afraid of nothing.

items.example: When someone is in trouble, do people stop and help or just walk on by?
items.mnemonic: Волк проходит мимо — walk on by.

items.example: Stunt performers take risks for a living.
items.mnemonic: Каскадёр с рысью идёт на риск — take risks.

items.example: Broken bones are all part of the job.
items.mnemonic: Каскадёр с партией терпит — all part of the job, часть работы.

items.example: She woke up with a few aches and pains.
items.mnemonic: Каскадёрша охает «ахи» от болей — a few aches and pains.

items.example: In the end she's a family person.
items.mnemonic: Энт в конце концов домой — in the end.

items.example: Most stunt performers talk about the excitement, the challenge and the big money.
items.mnemonic: Каскадёр трясёт мани — the big money, большие деньги.
